An update on Bluefin’s next chapter.

What began as a single product has grown into a multi-product ecosystem. Bluefin has processed more than $100B in cumulative trading volume and grown to more than 2.5M accounts. Bluefin Perps has been a core part of that growth, and the community around it helped build the foundation for what Bluefin is today.

As the Sui team internalizes more of the network’s perps initiatives, we believe Bluefin’s resources are best focused on opportunities that complement that direction. Our focus will be on growing Bluefin Spot, alongside opportunities in tokenization
